svg.text: SQRL Acorn CLE-101 (LiteFury) to Compute Blade
CM4 or CM5. Header pins carry the numbers printed on the blade: 1 to 5 down the left, 6 to 10 down the right.
These are GPIO (IO) numbers, not the printed pin numbers
openFPGALoader --cable libgpiod, in the order TDI : TDO : TCK : TMS
the 4-pin header beside it is the UART: not that one
pin 1 = the end nearest the M.2 edge
pin 1 = the end nearest the M.2 edge
Cut the VCC wire (pin 6) of BOTH cables. 3.3 V from the Acorn into the header can destroy the host.
Every wire in the Molex cables is black: count from pin 1.
Photos: Uptime Lab (Compute Blade), RHS Research (LiteFury underside; the Acorn is the same PCB)
